notes.title: Space dwelling just got a whole lot better.
notes.content:
Attention all Earthlings, we're pleased to announce massive upgrades to the Phalasius Space Station OS to improve quality of life abroad the ship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/67b823e5282ab9e6203466f67dd1dac901520425.jpg[/img]

Here's the list:
[olist]
[*] Much better BJ positions and handling of the love toy
[*] The intensity meter logic is working much better now, don't get boring with one position only
[*] Hair for some of the characters have been improved
[*] Some strange facial expression have been removed and new ones added instead
[*] Camera system issues have been addressed
[*] Moneyshot positions
[/olist]

And the best part...
The threesome has been rebuilt to offer a way better experience!
Now all characters will be actively involved in the positions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/9267e93f7d1c2871314ac7a72f4d0538ef54a2e3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/4bff996ac639be1757151c2782330ddb8841dae3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/7d34e9fabf3fb97f3ff93f50d55f106f82539cf5.gif[/img]
Altogether, we believe it's a much better game now but as always... we are committed to keep pushing updates and constantly improving the game.
Please let know if you are running into issues, we love to hear your feedback.

notes.title: Loading time optimization and new POV for VR
notes.content:
Happy Friday,
We've just pushed a new update which will make loading time faster and run a bit smoother.
We've also adjusted the default POV in VR to have a tilt towards the action which makes for a more comfortable viewing experience.
We are still working on farther optimizing load time and performance optimization that will be ready in about a month.
Enjoy.

notes.title: Ground Control to Space Sinners!
notes.content:
Hi there! It’s been a while since we last talked, but we have a really exciting MASSIVE update packed with new features for you all… So take your protein pills, put your helmet on and let’s take a look.


[h2]Floating in a most peculiar way[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/39610441ccb7a90bf5cabc93e2772d1bc9f273b8.gif[/img]

We’ve added a bunch of new animations to all the locations in the game, with these new poses you’ll be able to discover new spots in the environment like never before. Against the bed headboard, in the shower or over the ship control panel! Lots of possibilities…


[h2]My spaceship knows which way to go[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/6300db02eb5d11a297a82b2c94b1510d94b55456.gif[/img]

We’re bringing to SpaceSEX a super requested feature by all of you, the Money Shot!
As you have fun with the girls, you will now see an intensity meter for each of the characters. You can increase each character’s pleasure by picking their favorite positions and having a good timing. But the meter can decrease as well so try to not be too boring nor too anxious!

Once the meter is filled pick one of the different Money Shot poses and you’ll reach the grand sticky finale!


[h2]Commencing countdown, cameras on![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/36ec3b0d2362761522c8956b5bc9713b0ff2601f.gif[/img]

We have a new exciting feature for all our PC users, now you can switch up between 2 camera modes, our regular free-movement camera and a new pre-fixed camera angles mode with the hottest shots of the action for a more cinematic-like experience!

[h2]And the stars look very different today…[/h2]

And last but not least we have some news regarding the galaxy famous peace-disturbing Aiden’s piece.
He was a bit jealous ever since Lance came around and Nov-A had a taste of his huge green meat pole, so we took him to the Dr. Molly’s Space Clinic in the Sex Moon of Saturn and now he’s really packing something from another galaxy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/db366277f382713b1efa9d9d64dec415e78376b5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Exiting Early Access
notes.content:
Dear Space Travelers,

Over the last few months, our team of Space Developers has been improving many aspects of Space SEX, for both VR and PC.  I have personally approved the current release as ready to leave Early Access, so we may start our journey together.  A huge thanks to everyone who purchased our app while it was still in Early Access.

There still is a long list of awesome features that our crew will continue to implement in 2021 and we’ve already started working on new content that will continue the story, in which you will finally meet the hot green alien.  
Have a wonderful weekend and I look forward to serving you in 2021.

Captain Scanlon


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37786342/29e72e3cb93b447188d3a94283ce63ce9bb6fdec.png[/img]

notes.title: Major VR update to UI and controllers
notes.content:
VR Space dudes.
We’ve just pushed a big update and completely replaced the VR UI. The new UI can now be controlled with your weak hand so you can use your strong hand to control your personal joystick.
Additionally, we’ve improved the speech bubbles and cameras in the VR stories.
To see this update please right-click SpaceSEX in your steam.exe and go to settings >> betas and select the beta-vr branch.
Hope you enjoy the new update and please let us know if you see any bugs or other issues.
Have a wonderful weekend.
SpaceSEX

notes.title: A special announcement from Captain Scanlon:
notes.content:
We’ve just pushed a new update to Space SEX that includes full VR support for Oculus and Vive headsets, as well as many bug fixes.  This latest build will auto-detect your headset and launch the appropriate sdk based on your device. This is a big step forward towards exiting out of Early Access.  Please report any related bugs to support@sinvr.com.

Additionally, we are working on the next 5 chapters of the story, with a slew of new hot characters who get tangled up in a hilarious plot.

Stay tuned for more info soon!
